summary: Knox County Schools urges the Commission to reject proposals that would terminate or materially reduce the eligibility or support available to school districts such as KCS. Specifically, they recommend rejecting proposals to terminate or limit E-Rate funding, as E-Rate-funded connectivity is essential to core district operations, not just classroom instruction. The KCS argues that eliminating E-Rate would have significant budgetary impacts, equivalent to the cost of hiring 88 additional teachers.
